drafts.explanation: Picks the silver spoon identified by moved role and places it inside the white plastic tub container.

drafts.code:
def run(scene, robot):
    moved = scene.with_role("moved")
    spoon = moved[0] if moved else scene.of_kind("spoon")[0]
    tub = scene.containers()[0]
    spoon = scene.get(spoon.name)
    tub = scene.get(tub.name)
    if scene.is_inside(spoon, tub):
        return
    robot.pick(spoon)
    robot.place_in(tub)
